#  13033 - Magnetism of Solids Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **13033 - module is no longer offered from WS 2025/26**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Magnetism of Solids**  |  
|  Magnetismus in Festkörpern   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. rer. nat. habil. Seibold, Götz 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Each summer semester even year   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | After successfully completing the module, students have acquired basic knowledge in the physics of magnetism with regard to theoretical and phenomenological aspects. They understand the connection between basic and applied science and know methods of attaining new perceptions.Additionally the module supports presentation skills and further competences as accurateness, endurance and curiosity.  |  
| Contents:  | Second quantization, atomic magnetism, crystal field theory, dia- and paramagnetism, exchange interactions, spin-interactions in solids, Heisenberg model, Hubbard model, itinerant electron magnetism, spin-waves.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | 
  * Basic (Bachelor) knowledge of solid state theory and theoretical physics.

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 150 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * S. Blundell: Magnetism in Condensed Matter
  * W. Nolting, Fundamentals of Many-body Physics
  * W. Nolting, Quantum Theory of Magnetism
  * D. C. Matthis, The theory of magnetism

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Prerequisite + Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  |  **Prerequisite:**
  * Successful completion of exercise assignments (75% must be reached)

**Final module examination:**
  * Oral examination, 30-45 min.

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | 
  * Study programme Physics M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in the complexes „Physical Specialization with Theoretical Focus“ and „Physical Specialization with Experimental Focus“, topic area „Condensed Matter Physics“

Self organised studies comprise reworking of the lecture and solving of exercises.  |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Lecure: Magnetism in the Solid State 
  * Accompanying exercises
  * Related examination

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
